read_sdf_binary: read a signed distance field from a binary volume file and parameters JSON in a given directory
read_sdf_txt: read a signed distance field and transform from Habitat-sim output text files in a directory
merge_sdfs: merge two aligned voxel grid SDFs by taking the minimum value in overlapping regions
sdf_from_mesh: compute a signed distance field from a trimesh mesh with a specified voxel size and padding
SDFTriInterp: interpolate signed distance field values at arbitrary 3D points using trilinear interpolation on a voxel grid
